correction: Do not describe @JvmOverloads as deleting every parameter to the right of a default-valued parameter. It generates overloads by omitting default-valued parameters successively; required parameters remain in the generated signatures. The official API wording is 'all but the last one that takes a default value'; the interop guide illustrates removing each defaulted parameter and parameters to its right, interpreted with remaining required parameters preserved. MixedDefaults probe (Kotlin 2.4.10/JVM 17) preserves required host and yields connect(String,String), connect(String).
constructor_exception: When all constructor parameters have default values, Kotlin/JVM provides a public zero-argument constructor even without @JvmOverloads; this exception does not generally apply to ordinary methods.
